interactables.text: The [Movie Star] weeps. 'I heard Rudebeak. At [8:00 PM]. It was definitely him — I'd know that screech anywhere. He was here.'
The [Empty Cage]. The latch is [snapped clean off]. The seed tray is bone dry. The feathers have settled — they've been here for hours, not minutes.
Tucked behind the cage stand, half-hidden by a fern: a small [Wireless Speaker]. A thin [Audio Cable] trails behind the furniture toward the wall.
A film crew camera on a tripod. The red light says [Recording]. It's been on all day. Someone forgot to check if it was aimed at the [cage].
A booklet: 'Phrases We've Taught Rudebeak.' Entries include: 'Hello gorgeous' ✓ | 'Oscar worthy' ✓ | '[Garbage slop]' ✓ — crossed out, labeled: '[Maid's fault]'.
